# Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd

> A Huntingdonshire family company founded in 1955, now running trading businesses in commercial finance, Cyber Essentials certification and publishing, alongside data services taken on directly. Company number 00598511. Registered office: Fenland House, 15b Hostmoor Avenue, March, Cambridgeshire PE15 0AX. ICO registration ZA900683.

Work is led by Peter Edwards ACMA CGMA, a chartered management accountant with over twenty years in senior finance roles.

Note on entities: regulated accountancy work — preparing a smaller authority's Annual Governance and Accountability Return (AGAR), and charity independent examination — is not carried out by Edwards Bros. That work is provided by Glebe Assurance, a trading name of Insight Professional Partners Ltd, through which Peter Edwards works as a CIMA Member in Practice. Glebe Assurance cannot both prepare an authority's return and act as its internal auditor.

## Services

- [Data clean-up and analysis](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/data.html): Consolidating spreadsheets, system exports and PDFs into one clean dataset with committee-ready reporting. For parish and town councils, charities and CIOs, village halls, sports clubs, PCCs, internal drainage boards and residents' management companies — organisations with statutory or funder reporting obligations and no finance department.

## Guides for parish and town councils

- [Setting the precept: a clerk's walkthrough](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/setting-the-precept-parish-council.html): The budget, the tax base, the Band D figure, and the January deadline.
- [AGAR variance explanations that don't come back as a query](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/agar-variance-explanations.html): Worked examples box by box of Section 2 variance explanations, and the three wordings the external auditor queries every year.
- [When the external auditor's query lands](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/pkf-littlejohn-query-response.html): The cause-amount-evidence structure that closes a PKF Littlejohn query in one round.
- [The parish council fixed asset register](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/parish-council-fixed-asset-register-template.html): The columns a register needs, the historic cost rule, and how to rebuild one that no longer agrees to Box 9.
- [Cyber Essentials for parish councils](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/cyber-essentials-parish-councils.html): Why the clerk's home laptop is in scope, councillors' own devices, and the two answers that fail an assessment outright.

## Guides for internal drainage boards

- [The AGAR for internal drainage boards](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/internal-drainage-board-agar.html): How drainage rates, special levies, pumping station assets and shared administration make several AGAR boxes behave differently from a parish council's.

## Guides for charities

- [A charity reserves policy trustees can actually use](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/charity-reserves-policy-example.html): How to calculate free reserves, arrive at a defensible target, and write the policy — with a worked example.
- [Independent examination or audit?](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/charity-independent-examination-threshold.html): The income and asset thresholds for England and Wales, who can act as examiner, and the governing document trap.
- [Cyber Essentials for charities](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/cyber-essentials-for-charities.html): Trustees' and volunteers' own devices, the shared mailbox problem, and the two automatic failures.

## Guides for village halls and community buildings

- [What does an hour in the hall actually cost?](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/village-hall-hire-charges.html): Calculating the true cost per hour including the sinking fund, building a defensible rate card, and taking an increase to the committee.

## Guides for small businesses

- [What is a PPON?](https://www.edwardsbros.co.uk/insights/what-is-a-ppon.html): The Public Procurement Organisation Number required under the Procurement Act 2023, how to register, and how share codes work.

## Trading businesses

- [Granton Finance](https://granton.finance): Commercial finance broking — acquisition, management buyout, succession and refinance funding. FIBA member FIB42279.
- [PassCyber](https://passcyber.co.uk): Cyber Essentials certification prepared and managed for small organisations.
